basis: One-symbol target + nonempty emissions implies exactly one source token. Exclusive origin must be legal as a complete word; E_nonfinal/N_nonfinal are not; singleton S emits q under frozen priority. No sourcebook, prefix or free-UD assumption.

alias.limit: Source-free finite lexicon witness only; not a German reading or universal uniquely decodable code.

boundary.relaxed_assumption: one complete source word per visible group

S_single_priority.limit: An alternate one-letter-S priority does not affect the14fits but changes the frozen encoder. A/E obstruction does not depend on this choice.

limits: Conditional on original group/working-unit boundaries; no new palaeography.
Common a is one physical locus, not three confirmations.
l supports only the frozen singleton-S priority; changing it does not repair a.
Origin-exclusive completion is an added submodel; contextual aliases remain open and can preserve word-level uniqueness.
No general German, phonetic or arbitrary-code exclusion; parent raw proposal remains inconclusive.
